metrics.answerText:
**Q3 fixture widget recall — verdict from the independent lab reports**

I read all three dossiers at the [recall brief](http://127.0.0.1:45979/recall-brief) and opened each one's linked independent lab report.

**Supported: bearing seat machining** — [lab report](http://127.0.0.2:37001/lab-bearing): "Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED."
- The measurement it rests on: bearing seats **0.4 mm undersize** on every recalled batch.

**Ruled out: ceramic coating cure** — [lab report](http://127.0.0.2:37001/lab-coating): "Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported."

**Ruled out: packaging compression** — [lab report](http://127.0.0.2:37001/lab-packaging): "Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported."

scenarios.command: three consignments are listed at http://127.0.0.1:45979/consignment-index. each one's custody record is a chain of eight legs, and every leg links only the next one, so the seal number is on the last leg of each chain. for all three consignments, follow the whole chain and tell me the port it departed from and its container seal number

args.headline: Trace three consignment custody chains — ports and seal numbers
args.objective: For all three consignments listed at http://127.0.0.1:45979/consignment-index, follow each eight-leg custody chain to its final leg and report each consignment's departure port and container seal number.

args.task: Trace the custody chain for Consignment Falcon. Start at http://127.0.0.1:45979/consign-falcon (leg 1 of an 8-leg chain). Each leg page names its own handover and contains a link to only the next leg; follow the chain link by link using the numbered refs/hrefs shown until you reach the 8th (last) leg, which carries the container seal number. On the last leg, do NOT follow any further link — the chain ends there; read the seal number from that page. Report back: (1) the departure port of the consignment (on the first leg page, consign-falcon), (2) the container seal number (on the final leg page), (3) the URL of the final leg, and (4) a one-line list of the handovers in order. Quote the exact text lines from the first and last leg pages that contain the port and the seal number.

Trace the custody chain for Consignment Marlin. Start at http://127.0.0.1:45979/consign-marlin (leg 1 of an 8-leg chain). Each leg page names its own handover and contains a link to only the next leg; follow the chain link by link using the numbered refs/hrefs shown until you reach the 8th (last) leg, which carries the container seal number. On the last leg, do NOT follow any further link — the chain ends there; read the seal number from that page. Quote the exact text lines from the first and last leg pages that contain the port and the seal number.

Trace the custody chain for Consignment Ibex. Start at http://127.0.0.1:45979/consign-ibex (leg 1 of an 8-leg chain). Each leg page names its own handover and contains a link to only the next leg; follow the chain link by link using the numbered refs/hrefs shown until you reach the 8th (last) leg, which carries the container seal number. On the last leg, do NOT follow any further link — the chain ends there; read the seal number from that page. Report back: (1) the departure port of the consignment (on the first leg page, consign-ibex), (2) the container seal number (on the final leg page), (3) the URL of the final leg, and (4) a one-line list of the handovers in order. Quote the exact text lines from the first and last leg pages that contain the port and the seal number.

args.observation: Consignment Falcon departed from the port of Valdez (leg 1).

args.excerpt: Consignment Falcon arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-8123. This is the end of the chain.
args.observation: Consignment Falcon's container seal number is SEAL-8123 (leg 8 of 8, http://127.0.0.2:37001/custody-c8sy).

args.excerpt: Consignment Marlin departed Ostend on the first leg of its custody chain.
args.observation: Consignment Marlin departed from the port of Ostend (leg 1).

args.excerpt: Consignment Marlin arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-4470. This is the end of the chain.
args.observation: Consignment Marlin's container seal number is SEAL-4470 (leg 8 of 8, http://127.0.0.2:37001/custody-a5dw).

args.excerpt: Consignment Ibex departed Trieste on the first leg of its custody chain.
args.observation: Consignment Ibex departed from the port of Trieste (leg 1).

args.excerpt: Consignment Ibex arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-9056. This is the end of the chain.
args.observation: Consignment Ibex's container seal number is SEAL-9056 (leg 8 of 8, http://127.0.0.2:37001/custody-u3pk).

metrics.answerText:
All three custody chains (8 legs each) traced to their final legs.

| Consignment | Departure port | Container seal |
|---|---|---|
| Falcon | Valdez | SEAL-8123 |
| Marlin | Ostend | SEAL-4470 |
| Ibex | Trieste | SEAL-9056 |

**Falcon** — leg 1 ([consign-falcon](http://127.0.0.1:45979/consign-falcon)): "Consignment Falcon departed Valdez on the first leg of its custody chain." Final leg ([custody-c8sy](http://127.0.0.2:37001/custody-c8sy)): "Consignment Falcon arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-8123."

**Marlin** — leg 1 ([consign-marlin](http://127.0.0.1:45979/consign-marlin)): "Consignment Marlin departed Ostend on the first leg of its custody chain." Final leg ([custody-a5dw](http://127.0.0.2:37001/custody-a5dw)): "Consignment Marlin arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-4470."

**Ibex** — leg 1 ([consign-ibex](http://127.0.0.1:45979/consign-ibex)): "Consignment Ibex departed Trieste on the first leg of its custody chain." Final leg ([custody-u3pk](http://127.0.0.2:37001/custody-u3pk)): "Consignment Ibex arrived on the final leg under container seal SEAL-9056."

Each chain's handover route: Falcon — Valdez → Northline Freight → Depot 12 → Kettle Point customs → Weighbridge 3 → Harrow Surveying → Bay 18 → arrival. Marlin — Ostend → Cormorant Haulage → Depot 27 → Ravensgate customs → Weighbridge 9 → Lyle Marine Survey → Bay 4 → arrival. Ibex — Trieste → Sablefish Lines → Depot 41 → Marrow Crossing customs → Weighbridge 6 → Osprey Inspectorate → Bay 31 → arrival.
